sql.baselineItems:
WITH media AS (
 SELECT a.id AS "artworkId", a.title, a.source, i.id AS "imageId", latest.id AS "latestJobId",
 CASE WHEN latest.id IS NULL THEN 'NONE'
 WHEN latest.status::text IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','RETRY_WAIT','PAUSING','PAUSED','CANCELLING') THEN 'ACTIVE'
 ELSE latest.status::text END AS status
 FROM "Artwork" a JOIN "Image" i ON i."artworkId"=a.id
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
 SELECT recent.id, recent.status FROM (
 (SELECT j.id,j.status,j."createdAt" FROM system_jobs j WHERE j.type='VIDEO_STREAMING_OPTIMIZATION' AND j."definitionVersion">0 AND j.payload #> '{imageId}'=to_jsonb(i.id) ORDER BY j."createdAt" DESC,j.id DESC LIMIT 1)
 UNION ALL
 (SELECT j.id,j.status,j."createdAt" FROM system_jobs j WHERE j.type='VIDEO_STREAMING_OPTIMIZATION' AND j."definitionVersion"=0 AND j."legacyDisplay" #> '{targetImageId}'=to_jsonb(i.id) ORDER BY j."createdAt" DESC,j.id DESC LIMIT 1)
 ) recent ORDER BY recent."createdAt" DESC,recent.id DESC LIMIT 1
 ) latest ON true
 WHERE a."deletedAt" IS NULL AND a."archiveLifecycleState"='ACTIVE' AND lower(i.path) LIKE '%.mp4'
)
SELECT "artworkId",title,source,count(*)::int AS "mp4Count",
count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('NONE','FAILED','CANCELLED','SKIPPED'))::int AS "matchingMp4Count",
count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('NONE','FAILED','CANCELLED','SKIPPED') AND status <> 'ACTIVE')::int AS "actionableMp4Count",
jsonb_build_object('NONE',count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='NONE'),'ACTIVE',count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='ACTIVE'),'COMPLETED',count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='COMPLETED'),'FAILED',count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='FAILED'),'CANCELLED',count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='CANCELLED'),'SKIPPED',count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='SKIPPED')) AS "statusCounts",
(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(creators ORDER BY creators.name,creators.id),'[]'::jsonb)
 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ca.id,ca.name FROM effective_artwork_creators c JOIN "Artist" ca ON ca.id=c."artistId" WHERE c."artworkId"=media."artworkId") creators) AS artists
FROM media GROUP BY "artworkId",title,source
HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('NONE','FAILED','CANCELLED','SKIPPED'))>0
ORDER BY "artworkId" DESC LIMIT 20 OFFSET 0;

current.text:
WITH media AS (
    SELECT a.id AS "artworkId", i.id AS "imageId", latest.id AS "latestJobId",
      CASE WHEN latest.id IS NULL THEN 'NONE'
        WHEN latest.status::text IN ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6) THEN 'ACTIVE'
        ELSE latest.status::text END AS status
    FROM "Artwork" a JOIN "Image" i ON i."artworkId" = a.id
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT recent.id, recent.status FROM (
        (SELECT j.id, j.status, j."createdAt" FROM system_jobs j
          WHERE j.type = 'VIDEO_STREAMING_OPTIMIZATION' AND j."definitionVersion" > 0
            AND j.payload #> '{imageId}' = to_jsonb(i.id)
          ORDER BY j."createdAt" DESC, j.id DESC LIMIT 1)
        UNION ALL
        (SELECT j.id, j.status, j."createdAt" FROM system_jobs j
          WHERE j.type = 'VIDEO_STREAMING_OPTIMIZATION' AND j."definitionVersion" = 0
            AND j."legacyDisplay" #> '{targetImageId}' = to_jsonb(i.id)
          ORDER BY j."createdAt" DESC, j.id DESC LIMIT 1)
      ) recent ORDER BY recent."createdAt" DESC, recent.id DESC LIMIT 1
    ) latest ON true
    WHERE a."deletedAt" IS NULL AND a."archiveLifecycleState" = 'ACTIVE' AND lower(i.path) LIKE '%.mp4'
  ),
    matching_artworks AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT "artworkId", count(*)::int AS "mp4Count",
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ($7,$8,$9,$10))::int AS "matchingMp4Count",
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ($11,$12,$13,$14) AND status <> 'ACTIVE')::int AS "actionableMp4Count",
        jsonb_build_object(
          'NONE', count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'NONE'),
          'ACTIVE', count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'),
          'COMPLETED', count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'COMPLETED'),
          'FAILED', count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'FAILED'),
          'CANCELLED', count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'CANCELLED'),
          'SKIPPED', count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SKIPPED')
        ) AS "statusCounts"
      FROM media GROUP BY "artworkId"
      HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ($15,$16,$17,$18)) > 0
    ), candidate_page AS (
      SELECT * FROM matching_artworks
      ORDER BY "artworkId" DESC LIMIT $19 OFFSET $20
    )
    SELECT (SELECT count(*)::int FROM matching_artworks) AS total,
      coalesce((
        SELECT jsonb_agg(item ORDER BY item."artworkId" DESC)
        FROM (
          SELECT p.*, a.title, a.source,
            (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(creators ORDER BY creators.name, creators.id), '[]'::jsonb)
              FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ca.id, ca.name FROM effective_artwork_creators c
                JOIN "Artist" ca ON ca.id = c."artistId" WHERE c."artworkId" = p."artworkId") creators) AS artists
          FROM candidate_page p JOIN "Artwork" a ON a.id = p."artworkId"
        ) item
      ), '[]'::jsonb) AS items
